title: The Wish for the Garden Next Year
youtube_title: The Wish for the Garden Next Year | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Listening all the way through is a gift you can give today.
summary: At a kitchen table before breakfast, chairs close, Mama begins to tell Niko about a wish for next year's garden, said in order of importance. Niko wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
